_comment: How the simulation's composite ratings are named for players. A player's STYLE SUMMARY is a display label derived from his two strongest composites (at least 'minimum'); it is never fed back into any game logic.

three.name: Sharpshooter
three.text: Spaces the floor and makes threes.

mid.name: Mid-range Scorer
mid.text: Scores from the elbows and the pull-up.

finishing.name: Rim Finisher
finishing.text: Gets to the basket and finishes.

creation.name: Shot Creator
creation.text: Makes his own shot off the dribble.

playmaking.name: Playmaker
playmaking.text: Sees the floor and sets teammates up.

steal.name: Ball Hawk
steal.text: Gets his hands on passes and dribbles.
